n: Freenove 4WD Car Kit for Raspberry Pi
t: A build-it-yourself robot car kit with a camera that uses a Raspberry Pi brain.
steps: Buy the kit from the Freenove Store or Amazon. Get a Raspberry Pi, a microSD card, two high-drain 18650 cells, and a charger too.
Flash Raspberry Pi OS onto the microSD card with Raspberry Pi Imager.
Download the Freenove code from GitHub and run the setup steps in the online tutorial.
Note your connection board version. The code asks for it later.
Build the car by following the assembly chapter.
Prop the car up with the wheels off the table. Run the module test for the motors, LEDs, and sensors.
Try the light-tracing car example first.
Start the server on the Pi and drive the car with video from the PC client.
meta: Open Code. From $69.95. A few stores.
